source: Gated DeltaNet-2: Decoupling Erase and Write in Linear Attention, arXiv:2605.22791v1, Table 3
caption: Accuracy on Single Needle-In-A-Haystack (S-NIAH) and Multi-Key Needle-In-A-Haystack (MK-NIAH) tasks from RULER.
setup: 1.3B parameters, 100B tokens of FineWeb-Edu, 4K training sequences -- the same recipe as this campaign's Table 2 comparison in published_gdn2_1p3B.json.
metrics: Percentages, RULER's own substring match over 500 samples a cell. Every published value is a multiple of 0.2 = 1/500, which is what makes the sample count checkable rather than assumed; a test enforces it.
grid: S-NIAH-1 and S-NIAH-2 are reported at 1K/2K/4K/8K, S-NIAH-3 and MK-NIAH-1 at 1K/2K/4K only. The missing 8K cells are not zeros -- they were not run -- so they are absent here rather than null.
note: ONLY THE RECURRENT BLOCK is transcribed. The paper's second block is hybrid, and its hybrids interleave 2K SLIDING-WINDOW attention where ours place full NoPE attention every fourth layer; those are different designs and comparing them reads as a result about the gate. The same exclusion is argued in published_gdn2_1p3B.json's note.
